entry.title: Gates Foundation commits 1 billion US dollars over two years to equitable AI
entry.summary:
I-Gates Foundation izibophezele ukunikela okungenani izigidigidi eziyi-1 zamadola aseMelika kuminyaka emibili ezayo ukwakha nokuletha i-AI enobulungiswa obungcono, lapho izigidi ezingu-400 ziyiswa emfundweni, ezingu-400 kwezempilo, ezingu-100 kwezolimo kanti ezingu-100 zisiza ukwakha idatha yokuqeqesha i-AI ezilimini ezingasizakali ngokwanele. Lesi sibophezelo sihamba noMbiko wesi-10 iGoalkeepers wesikhungo, obizwa ngokuthi Make This Matter: AI, Equity and the Choice We Can't Delay.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 6 ibuza ukuthi ubani owakha i-AI ngokuzibophezela, futhi kungobani. Isibophezelo sobuntu esikhulu kangaka, esihlose ukuvala igebe kumazwe ampofu kunawo wonke, sizoqondisa ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ze-AI kwezemfundo ezizofinyelela emakilasini aseNingizimu Yomhlaba i-Wits AHEAD ewacwaningayo.

Gates Foundation · Foundation press release accompanying its Goalkeepers report

entry.title: Systematic review of 105 studies finds Africa and Oceania missing from generative AI teacher research
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo oluhlanganisiwe olulandela indlela ye-PRISMA, olubheka izifundo ezingu-105 ezihloliwe ngontanga mayelana nothisha ne-AI ekhiqizayo, ezishicilelwe kusukela ngo-2023 kuzincwadi ezikhulu zobuchwepheshe bemfundo, luthola ukuthi ucwaningo lugxile kakhulu eShayina, eTurkey, e-United States nase-Spain, kanti i-Afrika ne-Oceania azimelelwe ngokwanele. Ukwazi kwabathisha nge-AI, ulwazi lwabo lokufundisa kanye nokuzethemba, ngokwesakhiwo se-TPACK, kubikezela kangcono impumelelo yokusetshenziswa kwe-AI ekilasini kunokuvele babe nokufinyelela ezinsizeni.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 3 ihlanganisa i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM nasekufundisweni kothisha. Ucwaningo lolu bukhulu kangaka luqinisekisa ukuthi ucwaningo lwe-Wits AHEAD mayelana nemfundo yothisha base-Afrika luvala igebe elesaziwayo, hhayi ukuphinda umsebenzi osuvele wenziwe kakhulu.

Education Sciences (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Stanford study finds a persistent 19% AI employment gap for young workers
entry.summary:
I-Stanford Digital Economy Lab ibika ukuthi ukuqashwa kwabasha abaneminyaka engu-22 kuya kwengu-25 emisebenzini ethinteka kakhulu yi-AI manje kuphansi ngamaphesenti angu-19 kunalokho okwakulindelekile uma bekulingana nontanga babo abangathintekile kangako, kusuka kumaphesenti angu-15 onyaka odlule. Lo mehluko udalwa ikakhulukazi ukwehla kokuqashwa kwabasebenzi abasha, hhayi ukuxoshwa okwengeziwe, futhi uthinta kakhulu imisebenzi esekelwe olwazini olufundiswa ezincwadini, njengobunjiniyela bezinhlelo zekhompyutha nokusiza amakhasimende.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 4 ibuza ukuthi i-AI iguqula kanjani indlela esuka eziqwini iye empilweni yansuku zonke. Lobu ubufakazi obucacile kunazo zonke kuze kube manje bokuthi imisebenzi yokuqala esekelwe olwazini incishiswa kuqala, okuqinisa isidingo somsebenzi wamakhono abathweswe iziqu ongagcini nje ngesiqu.

Stanford Digital Economy Lab · University research institute report

entry.title: New Global South framework sets conditions for responsible generative AI in teaching
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwebhibliyomethriki futhi oluhlelekile olushicilelwe ku-International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning lulandelela ukukhula okusheshayo kwemibhalo mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo enesibopho kwezokufundisa, futhi luphakamisa uhlaka lombono lwaseNingizimu Yomhlaba. Luthola ukuthi umkhiqizo wocwaningo uholwa yi-United States, iShayina ne-Australia, kanti kuhlonzwa ukuqwashisa ngokuziphatha, ukwethembana, ukwesekwa kwezikhungo, ukulungela kwengqalasizinda kanye nekhono le-AI njengezimo ezithinta kakhulu ukwamukelwa kwayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 6 ihlanganisa i-AI enesibopho, ukuziphatha, ubulungiswa nenqubomgomo. Lolu hlaka lunikeza i-Wits AHEAD isisekelo esihloliwe ngontanga sokwahlulela ukuthi ukwamukelwa kwe-AI ekhiqizayo emanyuvesi aseNingizimu kunesibopho ngempela, hhayi nje ukuthi kuyatholakala.

International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning (iJET) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: PISA 2025 finds 15-year-olds who skip AI chatbots for schoolwork outscore those who rely on them, as global reading skills fall sharply
entry.summary:
Imiphumela ye-PISA 2025 ye-OECD, eyethulwe ngomhla ziyi-8 kuMandulo 2026, ibonisa ukuthi amamaki okufunda ehle ngamaphuzu angu-28 emazweni e-OECD nangamaphuzu angu-16 kwamanye amazwe namanani omnotho ahlanganyelayo phakathi kuka-2015 no-2025, okungenye yezinto ezehla kakhulu selokhu lolu hlolo lwaqala. Umbiko uthola ukuthi abafundi abaneminyaka engu-15 abangasebenzisi ama-chatbot e-AI emsebenzini wesikole ngokuvamile bathola amamaki aphakeme kunalabo abawasebenzisayo, futhi ngaphezu komunye kwabane wabafundi uthi omakhelwane bakhe bayaphazamiseka ngamadivayisi edijithali eziningi zezifundo zesayensi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Isigxobo 5, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha nedatha yokusiza izinhlelo zemfundo nokuthatha izinqumo, sithola isibonakaliso esiqondile sohlelo lonke lapha: uhlolo lwezwe lonke oluxhumanisa ukuncika okuningi kuma-chatbot e-AI nemiphumela ebuthakathaka, isexwayiso i-Wits AHEAD esikuhlolisisa ngokuqondile mayelana nomsebenzi wayo wesigxobo 1 nge-AI ekhiqizayo ekufundiseni nasekuhloleni.

OECD (PISA 2025 Results, Volume I) · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Indian researchers show synthetic student data can train dropout early-warning systems without exposing real records
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi be-Parul University eNdiya, ababhala ejenali i-Scientific Reports ye-Nature, bakhe uhlelo lokufunda komshini oluqeqesha amamodeli wesexwayiso sangaphambili sokuyeka isikole ngedatha ye-abafundi eyenziwe ngokobuchwepheshe ngaphambi kokulungisa ngengxenye encane yedatha yangempela. Iqeqeshwe ngokugcwele ngabafundi abangu-20 000 abenziwe ngokobuchwepheshe kwizifundo ezingu-180, imodeli ikwazile ukubona ngokunembile amaphesenti angu-47.3 abafundi abasengozini ngesonto lesine, futhi yafinyelela isilinganiso sokunemba esingu-0.831 ngemuva kokulungiswa nge-ngxenye eyodwa kwezinhlanu yedatha yangempela, eduze nesilinganiso esingu-0.842 esatholakala ngokuqeqesha kuphela ngedatha yangempela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Isigxobo 2, i-AI nokuhlaziya okubikezelayo empumelelweni yabafundi, sithola impendulo esebenzayo enkingeni yangempela: amanyuvesi angakwazi ukwabelana ngedatha ebucayi yabafundi angakwazi nokho ukwakha izinhlelo zesexwayiso sangaphambili ezithembekile mayelana nokuqhubeka, indlela i-Wits AHEAD engayilinganisa nomsebenzi wayo mayelana nokuqhubeka nokugcinwa kwabafundi.

Scientific Reports (Nature Portfolio) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: UNESCO-ICHEI dialogue in Kathmandu charts ethical, gender-inclusive AI integration for South Asian universities
entry.summary:
Ihhovisi le-UNESCO eKathmandu, i-Tribhuvan University, i-Asian Development Bank ne-UNESCO-ICHEI babuthanise abaholi bemfundo ephakeme nezikhulu zikahulumeni base-Asia eseNingizimu ngomhla zingama-20 kuNhlaba 2026 ukuze bahlele lokho inkulumo ka-Shafika Isaacs ekubize ngokuthi uhlelo lwe-AI oluhlanganisayo nolulungile. Ingxoxo ikhombe ingqalasizinda yedijithali engalingani, amakhono e-AI alinganiselwe kubafundisi, kanye nezinqubomgomo zamazwe ezingaxhumene njengezithiyo eziyinhloko zesifunda, futhi yethula isikhungo sikazwelonke se-ICHEI eNepal e-Tribhuvan University sokwakha amakhono e-AI, futhi yandulela umbiko ozayo mayelana noguquko lwedijithali kwimfundo ephakeme ye-Asia eseNingizimu.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Isigxobo 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana nezinqubomgomo, kanye nesigxobo 3, i-AI kwimfundo yesayensi neyothisha, kokubili kuvela ngokuqondile lapha: isikhungo sesifunda sokwakha amakhono kanye nesibopho esiqanjiwe sokubandakanywa ngokugcwele kwamantombazane nabesifazane ezifundweni nemisebenzini ehlobene ne-AI kunikeza isibonelo i-Wits AHEAD engasilinganisa nezikhala zayo zezinqubomgomo eNingizimu Afrika.

UNESCO · UN agency article

entry.title: Cyprus study finds science teachers eager for AI but held back by confidence gaps and thin pedagogical training
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwe-Frontiers in Education olwenziwe kothisha abangu-43 besayensi abasebenzayo eCyprus, oluholwa ngu-Christiana Karousiou noMaria Evagorou be-University of Nicosia, lwathola ukuthi cishe amaphesenti angu-70 abheka ubuchwepheshe njengobubalulekile kakhulu emiphumeleni yokufunda, kodwa amaphesenti angu-7 kuphela ayezethemba ekusebenziseni amathuluzi e-AI ngaphambi kokuqeqeshwa, kanti amaphesenti angu-65.1 ayengazethembi ngokuqondene nokulingiswa namathuluzi asemoya. Ngemuva kokuqeqeshwa, othisha babona amandla e-AI ekufundeni okuqondene nomuntu ngamunye nasekumakeni okuzenzakalelayo, kodwa amaphesenti angu-83.7 asaqhubeka nokuveza ukushoda kolwazi lokufundisa lokuyisebenzisa kahle, kanti amaphesenti angu-74.4 ayekhathazekile ukuthi izobuthakathaka ukucabanga okujulile kwabafundi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Isigxobo 3, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwimfundo yesayensi neyothisha, kubhekwana nakho ngokuqondile: igebe leli cwaningo elilibhalile phakathi kwentshiseko kothisha nokulungela kwabo yilona okuyinto i-Wits AHEAD ezama ukuyivala ngomsebenzi wayo wokuqeqesha othisha.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: UNESCO report confronts AI's 'elephant in the room' questions for education
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO ikhiphe umbiko othi The Algorithm in the Room, oqoqe imibhalo emifushane engu-26 mayelana nendlela izinhlelo ze-algorithm ezishintsha ngayo imfundo, ukhishwe ngesikhathi seSonto Lokufunda Kwedijithali 2026 eParis. Umbiko uhlanganisa imibono yabafundi, othisha, ochwepheshe bocwaningo kanye nabenzi benqubomgomo, ugxile kwimibuzo eyisithupha ephathelene nokuzimela, ukukhula kwezobudlelwano, ukufundisa, ukuqonda, ukubuswa kwezinto kanye nekusasa lemfundo. Uchaza izinhlelo ze-algorithm njengodaba oluphuthumayo, olungakaxoxwa ngokwanele, oselusabalele ezinhlelweni zemfundo emhlabeni wonke.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, lo mbiko unika amanyuvesi aseNingizimu Yomhlaba imibuzo yokubusa ehlelekile yokuhlola izinqubomgomo zawo ze-AI, kunokuthatha izinhlaka ezakhelwe izinhlelo ezicebile.

UNESCO · UN agency report

entry.title: South African universities move from detecting AI use to redesigning assessment
entry.summary:
I-North-West University, i-University of Pretoria, i-Stellenbosch University ne-Wits, ngayinye iyacabanga kabusha ngendlela ebhekana ngayo ne-AI ekhiqizayo, isuka ekutholeni ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI iye ekuklanyeni kabusha uhlolo ngokwalo. I-Stellenbosch iyeke ukusebenzisa isishuceleli se-AI se-Turnitin ngemuva kokuthola ukuthi sasibeka amaphesenti angu-61.3 emisebenzi yabafundi abangakhulumi isiNgisi njengolimi lwabo lwokuqala njengeyenziwe yi-AI, kanti kwabakhuluma isiNgisi njengolimi lwabo bekungamaphesenti angu-5.1, kuyilapho i-North-West yaba yiyunivesithi yokuqala yaseNingizimu Afrika enenqubomgomo ye-AI esemthethweni futhi seyifundise abafundi abangaphezu kuka-3 000 ikhosi yamahhala yokwazi nge-AI.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Isigxobo 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo ekufundiseni, ekuhloleni nasekwethembekeni, sisakhiwa ngesikhathi sangempela emakhampasini aseNingizimu Afrika, kunezifundo eziqondile ku-Wits AHEAD mayelana nemihlahlandlela yayo ngokuhlolwa okulungile nokuthenjwayo.

TechCentral · Established South African technology press

entry.title: Study argues the EU AI Act requires rethinking STEM pedagogy, assessment and teacher agency
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo oluhlolwe ngontanga, olubhalwe nguKonstantinos Kotsis noGeorgios Stylos, luphikisana ngokuthi uMthetho we-AI we-European Union, uhlangene namandla akhulayo e-AI ekhiqizayo, udinga othisha be-STEM ukuthi bakhe kabusha ndawonye indlela yokufundisa, uhlolo, kanye nendima yabo yobungcweti, kunokuthi bathathe amathuluzi e-AI kancane kancane. Ababhali babiza ukwazi okuhlaziyayo nge-AI okubheka i-AI njengombambi osebenzayo ekukhiqizweni kolwazi, uhlolo olugxile enqubweni oluhlanganisa nezitatimende zokusetshenziswa kwe-AI, kanye nokuqeqeshwa kothisha okwandisiwe kwazi nge-AI nasekuqondeni imithetho.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Isigxobo 3, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwe-STEM nasemfundweni yothisha, sithola ucwaningo lomthetho oluvela eYurophu i-Wits AHEAD engaluqhathanisa nohlaka lwayo lwenqubomgomo ye-AI olusakhulayo eNingizimu Afrika.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: African Development Bank and La Francophonie launch digital skills and jobs partnership in five countries
entry.summary:
I-African Development Bank ne-International Organisation of La Francophonie basayine isivumelwano sokwandisa ukuqeqeshwa kwamakhono edijithali, ukusekelwa kobuchweshi bebhizinisi kanye nezindlela zokuqashwa kwabasha nabesifazane e-Benin, e-Cameroon, e-Guinea, e-Democratic Republic of the Congo nase-Madagascar. Isivumelwano, esisayinwe eParis, sihlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwezokwakha amawebhusayithi nama-app, ukuvikelwa kobuchwepheshe bedijithali, i-AI kanye nokuhlaziywa kwedatha, sakhelwe ohlelweni lwe-D-CLIC lwe-OIF, oselusuqeqeshe cishe abasha abayizi-19 000. Isigaba sokuhlolwa esizothatha izinyanga ezingu-12 kuya kwezingu-24 sizoqala ngaphambi kokwandiswa kwamanye amazwe angamalungu.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kuwuhlolo oluqondile lwesigxobo 4, i-AI, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, e-Afrika ekhuluma isiFulentshi, futhi kuyisibonelo i-Wits AHEAD engasibhekisela lapho ihlola ubambiswano lwamakhono e-AI kwenye ingxenye yezwekazi.

African Development Bank Group · Intergovernmental body press release

entry.title: Learning analytics study finds early-warning models plus relational feedback lift at-risk student engagement
entry.summary:
Ocwaningi bavela e-Monash University, e-University of Hong Kong nase-Vanderbilt University bahlanganise amamodeli wesexwayiso sangaphambili asebenzisa ukufunda komshini, afinyelela ukunemba kwesibikezelo esingaphezu kuka-0.8 AUC kumaqembu amasha abafundi, nama-imeyili empendulo yobudlelwano athunyelwe kubafundi abaphawulwe njengabasengozini. Ngaphezu kwamaphesenti angu-30 abafundi abaphawulwe baqhubeka nokubandakanyeka nemisebenzi yokufunda ababengakaze bayisebenzise ngaphambili phakathi namasonto amabili emva kokuthola i-imeyili yokungenelela, futhi iningi labafundi ababuzwa lalifisa ukuthola le mieyili kaningi kunohlelo lwakabili ngesemesta olwahlolwa.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 2, i-AI nokuhlaziywa okubikezelayo kwempumelelo yabafundi, ucwaningo lubonisa ukuthi isibikezelo sodwa asanele: ukusihlanganisa nempendulo yobudlelwano eklanywe ngokucophelela yikho okushukumisa ukubandakanyeka, isifundo esithinta ngokuqondile umsebenzi wesexwayiso sangaphambili ka-Wits AHEAD.

Journal of Learning Analytics · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Universities UK roadmap calls for AI built into every degree, with the University of Surrey as its model
entry.summary:
I-Universities UK ikhiphe uhlelo lwayo olubizwa nge-Future Jobs Roadmap, olwakhiwe kanye nabaqashi, izinhlangano zamabhizinisi namanyuvesi cishe angu-200, olucela wonke amanyuvesi ase-UK ukuba afake ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) kuzo zonke iziqu ngayinye kunokuba lifundiswe njengemodyuli yamakhono edijithali ehlukene. Lolu hlelo luqamba i-University of Surrey njengesibonelo, lapho zonke izifundo kusukela onyakeni wesisekelo kuya ezingeni le-postgraduate manje zinengxenye ye-AI ehambisana nomkhakha wazo, eyengamelwe umfundisi oyisipesheli kwi-AI, kanye nesibophezelo sokunika bonke abafundi be-undergraduate ithuba lokufunda emsebenzini ngo-2035.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 4, amakhono abathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka nezinguquko ezinobulungiswa, lubeka imodeli kazwelonke yokweluka ukwazi i-AI ngaphakathi komkhakha uqobo kunokuba kunanyathiselwe ngaphandle, umbuzo wokwakheka i-Wits AHEAD naso esisebenzela kuwo ezinhlelweni zokufunda kuwo wonke amazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

University of Surrey · University announcement

entry.title: African Development Bank and Korea's KAIST sign three-year deal to build African AI and digital governance skills
entry.summary:
I-African Development Bank kanye ne-Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology basayine isivumelwano sokubambisana seminyaka emithathu eSeoul mhla ka-9 Septhemba, emaphethelweni engqungquthela yesishiyagalombili yongqongqoshe ye-Korea-Africa Economic Cooperation. Isivumelwano sihlanganisa ucwaningo oluhlanganyelwe ngenqubomgomo yomphakathi ehlobene ne-AI kanye nedatha, kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwezikhulu zikahulumeni zase-Afrika, abacwaningi nochwepheshe bezobuchwepheshe, kanti leli Bhange libalela ukuthi i-AI ingangeza kuze kufike ku-trillion wamadola emnothweni wase-Afrika ngo-2035.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 5, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha nedatha yezinhlelo zemfundo nokuthathwa kwezinqumo, lokhu kuwumzila oqondile wokwakha amakhono ocwaningo nawenqubomgomo emkhakheni womphakathi adingwa yimfundo ephakeme yase-Afrika nezinhlelo zikahulumeni ukuze zisebenzise i-AI ngendlela enesibopho.

African Development Bank, reported by allAfrica · Intergovernmental body announcement

entry.title: Global survey of 45,000 students and staff finds AI use is high but guidance on using it well lags behind
entry.summary:
Inhlolovo ethi AI in Higher Education Global Survey 2026 ye-Digital Education Council, esekelwe ezimpendulweni ezingu-45 398 zabafundi nabafundisi emazweni angu-35, ithola ukuthi u-88 wamaphesenti wabafundi no-77 wamaphesenti wabafundisi manje basebenzisa i-AI ezifundweni zabo noma ekufundiseni, lokhu kwenyuke kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa no-2025. Ngu-29 wamaphesenti kuphela wabafundi okholwa ukuthi abafundisi babo bahlomile ngokwanele ukubaqondisa ekusebenziseni kahle i-AI, kanti ngu-31 wamaphesenti kuphela wabafundisi ozizwa ebandakanyeka ngendlela esemqoka ekwakhiweni kwenqubomgomo ye-AI yesikhungo sakhe.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, igebe eliphakathi kokwamukelwa okusheshayo nesiqondiso esihamba kancane yiwo kanye umbuzo wokubusa nobuqotho bemfundo ekuhloleni i-Wits AHEAD ewulandelayo kuzo zonke izikhungo ezisebenzisana nayo.

Digital Education Council · Global survey report

entry.title: Ten-year review finds AI research in STEM education growing fortyfold since 2016, but concentrated in the Global North
entry.summary:
Ukubuyekezwa kwe-bibliometric nokuhlaziya ucwaningo olungu-826 olubuyekezwe ontanga, olwashicilelwa phakathi kuka-2016 no-2025, okuholwe abacwaningi base-State University of Milagro e-Ecuador, kuthola ukuthi imibhalo eshicilelwa minyaka yonke ngobuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) emfundweni ye-STEM yenyuke isuka ku-4 yaya ku-176 kuleyo minyaka eyishumi, kanti i-United States ne-China yizona ezikhiqiza okuningi. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kubalula izindikimba ezinhlanu ezivelele zocwaningo, okuwukuhlaziywa kwedatha yokufunda, imfundo yobunjiniyela, ukwazi i-AI, ubuchwepheshe obuzikisayo kanye ne-AI ekhiqizayo, futhi kuveza ukungalingani okuqhubekayo kwendawo okuvuna amazwe aseNyakatho Yomhlaba, ucwaningo olumbalwa lwesikhathi eside kanye nezinhlaka zokuziphatha ezibuthakathaka.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 3, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwi-STEM nasemfundweni yothisha, lokhu kubuyekezwa kuqinisekisa kusuka kwimibhalo uqobo igebe i-Wits AHEAD ekhona ukuze ilivale, ngokuveza ukuthi ucwaningo lwamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba ngokufundisa i-AI kwi-STEM lusencane kangakanani.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Hong Kong nursing school builds a Cantonese language AI patient to train counselling skills
entry.summary:
I-Nethersole School of Nursing yase-Chinese University of Hong Kong yakhe lokho ekubiza ngemodeli yokuqala emhlabeni enkulu yolimi lwesiCantonese, esetshenziswa njengesiguli esidala esiyisithombe ukuze abafundi bezenhlalakahle nabobunesi bakwazi ukuzilolonga endleleni yokweluleka yesikhathi sangempela. Lolu hlelo, olwakhiwe nenkampani yezobuchwepheshe i-Votee AI, lwawina indondo yegolide embukisweni wesi-51 we-International Exhibition of Inventions eGeneva, futhi abalwakhi balo bathi idatha yokuqeqesha eyakhelwe kuphela ngesiNgisi ishiya abantu abacishe babe yizigidi ezingu-85 abakhuluma isiCantonese emhlabeni bengasizakali kahle kwi-AI ekhiqizayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, nakusigxobo 6, ukulingana, lesi yisibonelo esiqondile sokuthi ulimi olungemuva kwedatha yokuqeqesha i-AI lunquma ukuthi ubani ozuzayo ekufundiseni okusekelwe yi-AI, isexwayiso ezikhungweni ezisebenzela abafundi abakhuluma izilimi eziningi kuwo wonke amazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

Times Higher Education · Established press

entry.title: Springer Nature's journals policy chief says the real AI question in research is risk management, not disclosure alone
entry.summary:
Ebhalela i-Times Higher Education, inhloko yenqubomgomo yamajenali e-Springer Nature, u-Ellie Gendle, uthi ukushicilelwa kocwaningo bekulokhu kubuza umbuzo ongafanele nge-AI ekhiqizayo ocwaningweni: hhayi ukuthi ingabe yasetshenziswa yini, kodwa ukuthi izingozi zokusetshenziswa kwayo zilawulwa futhi zidalulwa kanjani. Ubeka uhlaka lwe-Springer Nature lwemigomo emihlanu, okuwukuziphendulela, ukusobala, ukugcinwa kwemfihlo, ukuzimela kokuhlelwa kanye nokwahlulela kwezemfundo, ehlukanisa i-AI esetshenziselwa ukwenza umbhalo ufundeke kalula kweyo eshintsha okutholakele okusemqoka, futhi ucaphuna ubufakazi benhlolovo ye-Oxford University Press obukhombisa ukuthi abacwaningi basakubika kancane ukusebenzisa kwabo i-AI ngoba besaba ukusolwa.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 6, i-AI enesibopho, ukuziphatha nenqubomgomo, lokhu kukhombisa lapho abashicileli abakhulu bebheke khona ngobuqotho bocwaningo, into ethinta ngqo indlela i-Wits AHEAD eyakha ngayo isiqondiso sayo socwaningo lwabafundi be-postgraduate nokuthunyelwa kwamajenali.

Times Higher Education · Established press, publisher policy

entry.title: Ecuadorian study of 980 students finds integrity culture, not device rules, predicts ethical generative AI use
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwabafundi abangu-980 emanyuvesi amabili ase-Ecuador lwasebenzisa i-structural equation modelling ukuthola ukuthi yini ebikezela ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ekhiqizayo ngendlela enesimilo emsebenzini wesifundo. Ubuqotho bemfundo nokusobala kwaba yisibikezelo esinamandla kunazo zonke, ngaphambi kokwazi ubuchwepheshe, ukucabanga okujulile kanye nesiqondiso sesikhungo, kanti le modeli ichaze u-44 wamaphesenti womehluko ekusetshenzisweni kwe-AI ngendlela enesimilo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, lokhu kusikisela ukuthi i-Wits AHEAD kufanele isekele isiko lobuqotho bemfundo esikhungweni kanye nemigomo yokudalula ngokusobala kunokuthembela ekuvinjelweni kwamadivayisi noma kusofthiwe yokuthola i-AI kuphela.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: South African study proposes 'early success indicators' in place of deficit based at-risk student labels
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi u-Philokuhle Majozi no-Kgadi Mathabathe baphakamisa uhlaka olusekelwe kwidatha lwezinkomba zempumelelo yokuqala kwinyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika, oluveza izikhathi ezibalulekile ohambweni lomfundi kusukela ekubhaliseni kuya ekuhlolweni kokugcina ukuze kubonakale lapho usizo ludingeka khona. Esikhundleni solimi olugxile ekuntulekeni lwabafundi abathiwa basengozini, lolu hlaka lubuza ukuthi yiziphi izimo okumele zibe khona ukuze abafundi baphumelele, okudinga ukubambisana kwesikhungo, isiko lokusobala kwedatha kanye nokungenelela okusheshayo nokuqondile.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 2, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo kwimpumelelo yabafundi, lunikeza enye indlela yaseNingizimu Afrika egxile emandleni abafundi esikhundleni sezinhlelo ezijwayelekile zesixwayiso sokuqala, i-Wits AHEAD engayisebenzisa ngqo.

Journal of Student Affairs in Africa · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Cape Town to host Times Higher Education's World Academic Summit for the first time in Africa
entry.summary:
I-University of Cape Town, kanye ne-University of Bristol kanye ne-Times Higher Education, izosingatha i-THE World Academic Summit kusukela mhla ka-29 Septhemba kuya mhla ka-1 Okthoba 2026, okungokokuqala ngqa le ngqungquthela ibanjelwa ezwenikazi lase-Afrika. Ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi Knowledge, justice and futures: Universities in the age of intelligence, uhlelo lunezingxenye ezine, kuhlanganisa i-AI enesimilo, ukufinyelela nokusungula okusha, kanti abahleli bathi uhlelo lwakhiwe ukuze kufakwe imibono yase-Afrika neyamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba ngokwesakhiwo hhayi njengento enanyathiselwe.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusigxobo 6, i-AI enesibopho, ukuziphatha nenqubomgomo, nakusigxobo 5, izinhlelo nokuthathwa kwezinqumo, le ngqungquthela iletha inkulumompikiswano yomhlaba nge-AI namanyuvesi eNingizimu Afrika, ithuba le-Wits AHEAD lokuxhumana ngqo, isemnyango wayo, nobuholi bemfundo ephakeme yomhlaba.

University of Cape Town · University announcement

entry.title: African universities confront AI's impact on jobs and learning at Dar es Salaam summit
entry.summary:
I-University of Dar es Salaam kanye ne-Michigan State University bavule umhlangano wonyaka ka-2026 we-Alliance for African Partnership mhla ka-16 Septhemba, oqhubeka kuze kube mhla ka-22 Septhemba ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi Reimagining Higher Education for Africa's Future: Leadership, Innovation and Global Partnerships. IPhini likaSekela Shansela wezoCwaningo, uSolwazi Nelson Boniface, uthe amanyuvesi ase-Afrika kumele axhume ulwazi nezinselele zomphakathi njengoba ebhekene nemibuzo evuswa yi-AI ekhiqizayo ekuhloleni nasocwaningweni. Ingxoxo yomphakathi ethi AI and the Future of Work ihlanganisa amazwi emfundo ephakeme, awezobuchwepheshe nawomkhakha ozimele mhla ka-17 Septhemba.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Leli yithuba eliyivelakancane lase-Afrika lonke eliholwa amanyuvesi elibeka umthelela we-AI emisebenzini nasekufundeni ohlelweni olulodwa nobuholi kanye nokubambisana, okukhuluma ngqo nesigxobo 4 esikhathalela amakhono abathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka nezinguquko ezinobulungiswa.

The Citizen (Tanzania), Alliance for African Partnership Annual Meeting 2026 · Established press

entry.title: World Bank convenes developing-country policymakers at Seoul AI-in-education academy
entry.summary:
I-Education and Skills Global Practice ye-World Bank yenze i-Global EdTech Policy Academy ngobuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) eSeoul kusukela mhla ka-31 Agasti kuya mhla ka-4 Septhemba 2026, kanye noHulumeni waseNingizimu Korea, i-Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office yase-United Kingdom kanye ne-Mastercard Foundation. Abakhi benqubomgomo basebenze ngokulungiselela okuku-inthanethi, izifundo ezijulile, ukuvakasha ezindaweni kanye nokufundisana ukuze bakhe amasu e-AI namapulani okusebenza ahambisana namazwe abo, besebenzisa ithulusi lobufakazi elinezinsiza ezingaphezu kuka-160.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Yilokhu kanye ukwakhiwa kwamandla ezingeni lezinhlelo isigxobo 5 esikulandelayo: ukuthi iminyango yezemfundo iguqula kanjani ubufakazi be-AI ibenze izakhiwo zokubusa namapulani okusebenza, okuthinta ngqo indlela izinhlelo zase-Afrika nezamanye amazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba ezakha ngayo amasu azo e-AI.

World Bank, Global EdTech Policy Academy on Artificial Intelligence · Intergovernmental body

entry.title: Technology acceptance study finds strong AI adoption among South African university students
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi base-Durban University of Technology nase-Mangosuthu University of Technology bahlole abafundi abangu-216 esikhungweni saseNingizimu Afrika esake sacindezelwa emlandweni besebenzisa i-Technology Acceptance Model eyandisiwe, lokhu kwashicilelwa kwi-Frontiers in Education mhla ka-3 Septhemba 2026. Ukubonakala kulula ukusebenzisa kubikezele ngamandla ukubonakala kuwusizo, ngokuhlobana okungu-0.728, kanti ukuba wusizo kubikezele ukusetshenziswa kwangempela kwe-AI, ngokuhlobana okungu-0.647, kuyilapho izimo zengqondo ezakhiwa yizindlela ezamukelwe umphakathi nazo zibikezele ukwamukelwa. Umehluko uvele ngokwezinga lokufunda nangekolishi kodwa hhayi ngobulili, ngeminyaka noma ngohlanga.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lolu ngolunye locwaningo olumbalwa lokwamukelwa kwe-AI olugxile esikhungweni saseNingizimu Afrika esake sacindezelwa emlandweni, olunika isigxobo 1 ubufakazi obuqondile bendawo bokuthi ukusetshenziswa kalula nezindlela zomphakathi kuyishayela kanjani i-AI ekhiqizayo ekufundiseni nasekuhloleni.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Journal of International Students paper frames AI adoption as a test of equitable internationalisation
entry.summary:
Ebhalela i-Journal of International Students mhla ka-29 Agasti 2026, u-Bindiya Jain wase-Poornima University uphakamisa uhlaka lwe-AI and Sustainable Internationalisation oluhlukanisa ukwamukelwa kwe-AI ezingeni lezinhlelo, okuqhutshwa yinqubomgomo, kokwamukelwa ezingeni lamathuluzi, okuqhutshwa ngabasebenzi kwimfundo ephakeme. Leli phepha lithi ukunakwa ngamabomu kwamazinga womabili, okuxhunywe ezinhlosweni zentuthuko esimeme zemfundo esezingeni eliphezulu nezokunciphisa ukungalingani, yikho okuvimbela ukwamukelwa kwe-AI ekukhuliseni igebe ledijithali emazweni asathuthuka.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kunika isigxobo 6 uhlaka lomqondo lokwahlulela ukuthi isinqumo sokwamukela i-AI, e-Wits AHEAD noma kwenye indawo emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba, sivala noma sikhulisa ukungalingani kwemfundo.

Journal of International Students · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Inside Higher Ed: universities are going all in on AI while the independent evidence base is described as almost nonexistent
entry.summary:
U-Kathryn Palmer ubika ukuthi i-OpenAI isithengise amalayisense angaphezu kuka-700 000 ezikhungweni ezibandakanya uhlelo lwe-California State University, kodwa abacwaningi base-MIT, e-Stanford nase-Ithaka S+R bathi ucwaningo oluqinile nolukhulu ngalokho i-AI ekwenzayo ekufundeni alukho futhi alubonakali luzofika maduze, ngokwengxenye ngoba amamodeli ashintsha njalo ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Ucwaningo lwekolishi lomphakathi olucashunwe kulo mbhalo luthole ukuthi ukufinyelela kumamodeli olimi amakhulu ngaphandle kwesiqondiso kwaba nomphumela ophambene.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Igebe eliphakathi kokuthengwa kwamathuluzi nobufakazi yilo kanye isikhala isigxobo 1 esisebenza kuso: ukwakha ucwaningo lokusetshenziswa kwe-AI ezifundweni zangempela, nabafundi base-Afrika nezimo zabo, izikhungo ezingenza ngalo okuthile ngaphambi kokuvuselelwa kwelayisense elilandelayo.

Inside Higher Ed · Established higher education press

entry.title: Chilean universities build and pilot a student-facing learning analytics app for first-year high-risk courses
entry.summary:
Iqembu eliholwa yi-Universidad de Concepción laxoxisana nabafundisi abangu-14 futhi lenza amaqembu okugxila angu-19 nabafundi abangu-140 emanyuvesi amathathu ase-Chile, labe selakha uhlelo lokuhlaziywa kwedatha yokufunda ngaphakathi kwesistimu yokuphatha ukufunda olunika abafundi, hhayi abafundisi, ithuba lokubuka idatha yabo yokufunda kuzo zonke izigaba ezintathu zikaZimmerman zokuzilawula. Izivivinyo ezimbili ezenziwe nabafundi bonyaka wokuqala abangu-267 ezifundweni ezinengozi enkulu zakhombisa ukuthi luyawusizo futhi lulula ukulusebenzisa uma kuqhathaniswa nenguqulo yangaphambili. Ababhali bathi okutholakele kusengokokuqala futhi kuvusa imibuzo yocwaningo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Izinhlelo eziningi zesixwayiso sokuqala zikhomba idatha kubeluleki, kodwa lolu lukhomba idatha kumfundi uqobo. Kusigxobo 2, ukwakhiwa okubhekiswe kumfundi kuyindlela ethembisayo yokugcinwa kwabafundi ezifundweni zesango zonyaka wokuqala, futhi isimo sase-Chile sisondelene nesethu ngobukhulu nangezinsiza.

Frontiers in Psychology · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Somali researchers argue for AI literacy as a foundational competency across secondary and tertiary education
entry.summary:
Ababhali base-Jamhuriya University of Science and Technology, i-Salaam University, i-East Africa University kanye ne-Benaadir Research, Consultancy and Evaluation Centre bathi i-Somalia akufanele ivimbe i-AI ekhiqizayo futhi akufanele iyamukele ngaphandle kwezivikelo. Besekela emibhalweni yakamuva nakwimibhalo yenqubomgomo, babeka ukusetshenziswa kwayo ekusekelweni kolimi, ekubhaleni izinhlaka zokuqala nasekufundiseni umfundi ngamunye, kanye nezingozi zokuqamba okungekho, ukuchema, ukweba imibhalo nokuphazamiseka kwemfihlo, futhi baqamba ukuthuthukiswa kothisha, ukubuyekezwa kohlelo lokufunda, ukuguqulwa kokuhlola kanye nesiqondiso sokuziphatha njengezinto ezibalulekile ekusebenziseni.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Impikiswano yenqubomgomo ebhalwe ngaphakathi kolunye lwezinhlelo zemfundo ezicindezeleke kakhulu ezwenikazi, ekushicilelweni okubuyekezwe ontanga, iyivelakancane futhi ibalulekile kusigxobo 6. Ikhombisa uhlelo lwe-AI enesibopho lubekwa amazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba kunokuba lungeniswe luvela kwamanye amazwe.

Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence · Peer-reviewed perspective article

entry.title: Meta-analysis of 35 experimental studies finds generative AI improves undergraduate learning outcomes, with effects that depend on how it is used
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi base-Zhejiang University of Technology, i-Nanjing Normal University kanye ne-East China Normal University bahlanganise ucwaningo olungu-35 lokuhlola nolucishe lufane nalo olwashicilelwa phakathi kuka-2022 no-2024. I-AI ekhiqizayo ibe nomthelela omuhle omkhulu kumakhono omsebenzi, u-g ongu-0.72, kanye nemithelela ephakathi ekusebenzeni kwezemfundo, u-g ongu-0.46, nasesimweni sengqondo, u-g ongu-0.44. Imithelela yalinganiswa ubude besikhathi sokungenelela, imodeli yokufundisa kanye nendlela abafundi abasebenzisana ngayo nethuluzi, kanti ababhali bayaxwayisa ukuthi imiphumela yamaqembu amancane isekelwe emasampuleni amancane.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Yilobu bufakazi obuhlanganisiwe isigxobo 1 esibudingayo lapho sicebisa ngokuhlola nangokwakhiwa kokufundisa, futhi bufika ngesonto elifanayo lapho ochwepheshe base-United States bechaza isisekelo sobufakazi esizimele njengesingekho nhlobo. Yizinto ezilinganisayo, hhayi umthelela osobala, okubalulekile ekwakhiweni kwezifundo.

Journal of Computer Assisted Learning (Wiley) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Education ministers adopt a joint statement to keep education a common good in the age of AI
entry.summary:
Ongqongqoshe abangaphezu kuka-25 nabameli abakhethiwe bamukele isitatimende esihlanganyelwe ekomkhulu le-UNESCO eParis mhla ka-8 Septhemba 2026, ekuvulweni kwe-Digital Learning Week. Sibeka izinto eziyisishiyagalombili ezibalulekile: izinhlelo ze-AI zenzuzo yomphakathi ezingacwaningwa, ukuvikelwa kokucabanga okujulile kwabafundi, amandla othisha, ukwakhiwa okuhambisana neminyaka, idatha yemfundo elawulwa enzuzweni yomphakathi, ukulingana okwakhelwe ngaphakathi, ukubalwa kwezindleko ngokugcwele ngaphambi kokwamukela, kanye namandla okubusa kazwelonke nasesifundeni. I-UNESCO iphinde yakhipha inhlolovo yayo yesibili yaminyaka yonke yama-UNESCO Chairs nge-AI kwimfundo ephakeme.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lesi yisitatimende esicace kunazo zonke phakathi kwamazwe sokuthi i-AI kwimfundo iyindaba yesinqumo somphakathi neyokuziphendulela, futhi siqamba ukulawulwa kwedatha, ukulingana kanye nezindleko eziphelele njengemibuzo yenqubomgomo. Sisekela isigxobo 6 futhi sinika iminyango namanyuvesi ase-Afrika indawo eyodwa yokubhekisela.

UNESCO, Digital Learning Week 2026 · Intergovernmental body

entry.title: UNESCO IESALC: AI is in use at 87 per cent of surveyed universities in Latin America and the Caribbean, but only 26 per cent have a formal strategy
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezingu-200 emazweni angu-19, olwethulwa e-Digital Learning Week, luthola ukuthi i-AI isetshenziswa okungenani kwesisodwa isigaba ku-87 wamaphesenti ezikhungo, nasekufundiseni nasekufundeni ku-74 wamaphesenti, ikakhulukazi ngamathuluzi ajwayelekile. Ngu-26 wamaphesenti kuphela onesu elisemthethweni le-AI, cishe uhhafu wabafundi ubika ukudideka ngokusetshenziswa okwamukelekile, kanti izikhungo ezizimele zingaphambili kunezikahulumeni ezintula izinsiza ekuhleleni, ekuqeqeshweni kwabasebenzi nasekubuseni.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Iphethini yokwamukelwa okusheshayo nokubusa okuhamba kancane, kanye negebe elikhulayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezinezinsiza ezanele nezikahulumeni, kufana nalokho esikubonayo eNingizimu ye-Afrika. Inhlolovo yezikhungo efanayo yesifunda se-SADC iyiphrojekthi eyimvelo yesigxobo 6, kanti okutholakele ngokudideka kwabafundi kukhuluma ngqo nenqubomgomo yokuhlola.

UNESCO IESALC · Intergovernmental body (UNESCO institute)

entry.title: 'Don't walk alone': Prof. Mwenda Ntarangwi on collaboration, AI and the future of African higher education
entry.summary:
Kuqoshwe emhlanganweni we-Collaborative eKigali ngaphambi komhlangano wayo we-Nairobi East Africa Hub ngo-Okthoba 2026. Kukhulunywa ngokubambisana, ngenqubekela phambili yalezi zizinda nangeqhaza lobuchwepheshe kwimfundo ephakeme yase-Afrika.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ubuholi base-Afrika bukhuluma kanye ngale ndlela yokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo i-AHEAD eyakhelwe kuyo.

The Education Collaborative, with the Vice-Chancellor of USIU-Africa · Vice-Chancellor, USIU-Africa; Education Collaborative convening

entry.title: University of Leicester gives Microsoft 365 Copilot to all 21,000 students and 4,000 staff
entry.summary:
Kusukela ngoSepthemba 2026 wonke umfundi nesisebenzi e-Leicester unokufinyelela okugcwele ku-Microsoft 365 Copilot, kuhambisana namamodyuli amakhono edijithali ayimpoqo aqedwa ku-Blackboard ngaphambi kokuvulwa kokufinyelela. I-Manchester yamemezela ukusatshalaliswa okufanayo kuso sonke isikhungo ngoJanuwari.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ukunikezwa kwe-AI kuso sonke isikhungo kushintsha izinga eliyisisekelo lobuqotho bemfundo, ukwakhiwa kokuhlola kanye nokulingana kokufinyelela. Kuyisibonelo esiphilayo sesigxobo 1 futhi kuyisilinganiso amanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika azokalwa ngaso.

University of Leicester · University announcement

entry.title: Are graduates prepared for the AI era?
entry.summary:
Umhleli we-Working It, u-Isabel Berwick, ubheka indlela izikhungo emhlabeni wonke ezisiza ngayo abathweswe iziqu ukuthola imisebenzi yabo yokuqala, kanye namathuluzi namakhono asize ekufuneni umsebenzi ngempumelelo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Umbuzo ka-Pillar 4 wokweqa kwabafundi besuka enyuvesi beya emsebenzini, uxoxwa ngasohlangothini lwabaqashi nolwabathweswe iziqu.

Financial Times, Working It · Financial Times

entry.title: Youth unemployment (15 to 34) rises to 47.4% in the second quarter of 2026
entry.summary:
Izinga elisemthethweni lokungasebenzi kwentsha linyuke ngamaphuzu ayizinkomba angu-1.5 laya ku-47.4% ekotheni yesibili ka-2026. Intsha engasebenzi yenyuke ngo-264 000 yaya ezigidini ezingu-5.0 kanti intsha eqashiwe yehle ngo-40 000 yaya ezigidini ezingu-5.6.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Leli yinani elilodwa elivikelekayo iqembu elilisebenzisayo kwizindlela zabathweswe iziqu nezinguquko ezinobulungiswa. Isigxobo 4 sibuza ukuthi i-AI ilubumba kanjani uhambo olusuka kwiziqu luya endleleni yokuziphilisa kwaleli qembu.

Statistics South Africa, Quarterly Labour Force Survey Q2 2026 · National statistics office

entry.title: Nigeria's AI education revolution: how AI is reshaping learning, from the University of Lagos
entry.summary:
Ochwepheshe bezemfundo e-UNILAG bakhuluma ngendlela i-AI eyibumba ngayo amakilasi nomsebenzi wezemfundo, nangesicelo sokuba kube khona isiqondiso, imithetho nokusetshenziswa ngokuzibophezela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kuvela esikhungweni esibambisene neqembu, futhi kuqondene ngqo no-Pillar 6.

News Central TV · Pan-African news channel

entry.title: World Development Report 2026: The Promise of Artificial Intelligence
entry.summary:
Lokhu kuwukuhlola kokuqala kwe-Bhange okugxile kuphela ku-AI emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi nephakathi, okubekwe njengokwamukela, ukujwayeza nokuqhubekisa. Amazwe anemali engenayo ephakathi enza uhhafu wethrafikhi ye-ChatGPT ezinyangeni eziyisithupha kuphela ngemva kokwethulwa kwayo, ukusabalala okusheshe kunanoma yibuphi ubuchwepheshe obujwayelekile obandulele, kodwa lo mbiko ubeka izimo zikagesi, zokuxhumana nezedatha okumele zifezwe ngaphambi kokuba i-AI ithuthukise izinsizakalo zomphakathi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lo mbiko uyisakhiwo senqubomgomo abaxhasi abazolisebenzisa eminyakeni emihlanu ezayo. Ukuma kwe-AHEAD okugxile emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba nasemakhonweni kuqala kuyimpendulo eqondile kuhlelo lwawo lokwamukela, ukujwayeza nokuqhubekisa.
